fact: The Copenhagen Consensus study states dLRev is a web-based application with a district digital address map and fiscal cadastre used to manage data, billing and collection of property rates and business permits, that 52 MMDAs were set up on the platform by the end of 2019 and nine used it throughout 2019, and that GIZ funded it.
title: The operationalization of the dLRev software for improved revenue mobilization at local government level: a cost-benefit analysis
